about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A passionate engineer who thrives on solving complex challenges and mentoring others.
content: As a Senior Software Engineer with 6 years of experience, I specialize in PHP, Python, and Node.js. My core focus lies in backend development, building scalable, testable, and performance-optimized systems.

I have hands-on expertise in designing CI/CD pipelines, writing clean, test-driven code, and integrating 3rd-party services. My strengths include API development, microservices architecture, and cloud-native tooling using Docker and Kubernetes.
I enjoy working with cross-functional teams, mentoring junior developers, and staying updated with AI, DevOps, and CMS technologies to continually deliver value and innovation.
